keyPoints.en: Coordination keeps all body systems working together in response to changes.
keyPoints.bm: Koordinasi memastikan semua sistem badan bekerjasama sebagai gerak balas terhadap perubahan.

keyPoints.en: External stimuli (light, sound, heat) and internal stimuli (blood glucose, CO₂ level) are detected by receptors.
keyPoints.bm: Rangsangan luar (cahaya, bunyi, haba) dan rangsangan dalam (glukosa darah, aras CO₂) dikesan oleh reseptor.

keyPoints.en: Pathway: stimulus → receptor → afferent pathway → integration centre → efferent pathway → effector → response.
keyPoints.bm: Laluan: rangsangan → reseptor → laluan aferen → pusat integrasi → laluan eferen → efektor → gerak balas.

keyPoints.en: Two coordinating systems: nervous (fast) and endocrine (slower, long-lasting).
keyPoints.bm: Dua sistem koordinasi: saraf (pantas) dan endokrin (lebih perlahan, tahan lama).

question.en: Identify the receptor and effector when your pupil shrinks in bright light.
question.bm: Kenal pasti reseptor dan efektor apabila pupil mengecil dalam cahaya terang.

answer.en: Receptor: photoreceptors in the retina. Effector: circular muscles of the iris.
answer.bm: Reseptor: fotoreseptor dalam retina. Efektor: otot membulat iris.

tip.en: Effectors are always muscles or glands.

keyPoints.en: Central nervous system (CNS): brain + spinal cord. Peripheral (PNS): nerves connecting the CNS to the body.
keyPoints.bm: Sistem saraf pusat (SSP): otak + saraf tunjang. Periferi (SSPe): saraf yang menyambung SSP ke badan.

keyPoints.en: Cerebrum: thinking, learning, memory, voluntary movement, senses.
keyPoints.bm: Serebrum: berfikir, belajar, ingatan, pergerakan terkawal, deria.

keyPoints.en: Cerebellum: balance and muscle coordination. Medulla oblongata: heart rate, breathing, blood pressure.
keyPoints.bm: Serebelum: keseimbangan dan koordinasi otot. Medula oblongata: kadar degupan jantung, pernafasan, tekanan darah.

keyPoints.en: Hypothalamus: body temperature, water balance, controls the pituitary. Spinal cord: reflexes and link to the brain.
keyPoints.bm: Hipotalamus: suhu badan, keseimbangan air, mengawal pituitari. Saraf tunjang: refleks dan penghubung ke otak.

keyPoints.en: PNS divides into somatic (voluntary, skeletal muscles) and autonomic (involuntary, organs).
keyPoints.bm: SSPe terbahagi kepada somatik (terkawal, otot rangka) dan autonomi (luar kawal, organ).

question.en: A person who drank too much alcohol walks unsteadily. Which brain part is affected?
question.bm: Seseorang yang terlalu banyak minum alkohol berjalan terhuyung-hayang. Bahagian otak manakah terjejas?

keyPoints.en: Neurone parts: dendrites (receive), cell body (nucleus), axon (carries impulse away), myelin sheath, axon terminals.
keyPoints.bm: Bahagian neuron: dendrit (terima), badan sel (nukleus), akson (bawa impuls keluar), salut mielin, terminal akson.

keyPoints.en: Afferent (sensory) neurones carry impulses to the CNS; efferent (motor) neurones carry them to effectors; interneurones link them.
keyPoints.bm: Neuron aferen (deria) membawa impuls ke SSP; neuron eferen (motor) membawanya ke efektor; neuron perantaraan menghubungkannya.

keyPoints.en: Myelin sheath insulates and speeds up impulses (jumping between nodes of Ranvier).
keyPoints.bm: Salut mielin menebat dan mempercepat impuls (melompat antara nod Ranvier).

keyPoints.en: At a synapse, neurotransmitters (e.g. acetylcholine) diffuse across the cleft and trigger an impulse in the next neurone.
keyPoints.bm: Di sinaps, neurotransmiter (cth. asetilkolina) meresap merentasi celah dan mencetuskan impuls dalam neuron berikutnya.

keyPoints.en: Synapses make impulses travel one way and allow integration of signals.
keyPoints.bm: Sinaps memastikan impuls bergerak sehala dan membolehkan integrasi isyarat.

question.en: Why do impulses travel in one direction only across a synapse?
question.bm: Mengapa impuls bergerak sehala sahaja merentasi sinaps?

answer.en: Only the presynaptic side releases neurotransmitters, and only the postsynaptic side has receptors.
answer.bm: Hanya bahagian prasinaps membebaskan neurotransmiter, dan hanya bahagian pascasinaps mempunyai reseptor.

tip.en: Draw and label a neurone and a synapse — both are common diagram questions.
tip.bm: Lukis dan label neuron dan sinaps — kedua-duanya soalan rajah yang biasa.

keyPoints.en: Voluntary actions are conscious and controlled by the cerebrum (walking, writing).
keyPoints.bm: Tindakan terkawal adalah sedar dan dikawal oleh serebrum (berjalan, menulis).

keyPoints.en: Involuntary actions are automatic: controlled by the medulla (heartbeat, breathing) or the spinal cord (reflexes).
keyPoints.bm: Tindakan luar kawal adalah automatik: dikawal oleh medula (degupan jantung, pernafasan) atau saraf tunjang (refleks).

keyPoints.en: Reflex arc: receptor → afferent neurone → interneurone in spinal cord → efferent neurone → effector.
keyPoints.bm: Arka refleks: reseptor → neuron aferen → neuron perantaraan dalam saraf tunjang → neuron eferen → efektor.

keyPoints.en: Knee-jerk reflex has only 2 neurones (no interneurone); withdrawal reflex has 3.
keyPoints.bm: Refleks sentakan lutut hanya ada 2 neuron (tiada neuron perantaraan); refleks tarik balik ada 3.

keyPoints.en: Reflexes protect the body by responding fast without waiting for the brain.
keyPoints.bm: Refleks melindungi badan dengan bertindak pantas tanpa menunggu otak.

question.en: Why do you feel pain only after pulling your hand away from a hot object?
question.bm: Mengapa anda hanya merasa sakit selepas menarik tangan dari objek panas?

answer.en: The reflex goes through the spinal cord first; the impulse to the brain (pain) arrives slightly later.
answer.bm: Refleks melalui saraf tunjang dahulu; impuls ke otak (sakit) tiba sedikit kemudian.

tip.en: Always mention the spinal cord as the integration centre for a reflex.
tip.bm: Sentiasa nyatakan saraf tunjang sebagai pusat integrasi refleks.

keyPoints.en: Alzheimer's disease: brain cells die → memory loss, confusion (mostly elderly).
keyPoints.bm: Penyakit Alzheimer: sel otak mati → hilang ingatan, keliru (kebanyakannya warga emas).

keyPoints.en: Parkinson's disease: lack of dopamine → tremors, stiff muscles, slow movement.
keyPoints.bm: Penyakit Parkinson: kekurangan dopamina → gegaran, otot kaku, pergerakan perlahan.

keyPoints.en: Multiple sclerosis: myelin sheath damaged → slow or blocked impulses.
keyPoints.bm: Sklerosis berbilang: salut mielin rosak → impuls perlahan atau tersekat.

keyPoints.en: Drug and alcohol abuse affect synapses, slow reactions and can cause addiction and brain damage.
keyPoints.bm: Penyalahgunaan dadah dan alkohol menjejaskan sinaps, melambatkan tindak balas dan boleh menyebabkan ketagihan serta kerosakan otak.

question.en: Why is it dangerous to drive after taking drugs or alcohol?
question.bm: Mengapa berbahaya memandu selepas mengambil dadah atau alkohol?

answer.en: They slow transmission at synapses, so reaction time increases and coordination is poor.
answer.bm: Ia melambatkan penghantaran di sinaps, jadi masa tindak balas bertambah dan koordinasi lemah.

tip.en: Link each disease to the part of the nervous system damaged.
tip.bm: Kaitkan setiap penyakit dengan bahagian sistem saraf yang rosak.

keyPoints.en: Endocrine glands are ductless; hormones travel in the blood to target organs.
keyPoints.bm: Kelenjar endokrin tiada duktus; hormon bergerak dalam darah ke organ sasaran.

keyPoints.en: Pituitary ('master gland'): growth hormone, TSH, FSH, LH, ADH.
keyPoints.bm: Pituitari ('kelenjar induk'): hormon pertumbuhan, TSH, FSH, LH, ADH.

keyPoints.en: Thyroid: thyroxine (metabolism). Adrenal: adrenaline (fight or flight). Pancreas: insulin and glucagon (blood glucose).
keyPoints.bm: Tiroid: tiroksina (metabolisme). Adrenal: adrenalina (lawan atau lari). Pankreas: insulin dan glukagon (glukosa darah).

keyPoints.en: Ovaries: oestrogen, progesterone. Testes: testosterone.
keyPoints.bm: Ovari: estrogen, progesteron. Testis: testosteron.

keyPoints.en: Most hormones are controlled by negative feedback.
keyPoints.bm: Kebanyakan hormon dikawal oleh suap balik negatif.

question.en: Describe the effects of adrenaline during a stressful situation.
question.bm: Huraikan kesan adrenalina dalam situasi tertekan.

answer.en: Faster heart rate and breathing, more glucose in blood, pupils dilate, blood diverted to muscles.
answer.bm: Kadar degupan jantung dan pernafasan lebih cepat, lebih glukosa dalam darah, pupil membesar, darah dialihkan ke otot.

tip.en: Learn gland → hormone → target → effect as a 4-column table.
tip.bm: Pelajari kelenjar → hormon → sasaran → kesan sebagai jadual 4 lajur.

keyPoints.en: Diabetes mellitus: too little insulin (type 1) or cells not responding (type 2) → high blood glucose.
keyPoints.bm: Diabetes melitus: terlalu sedikit insulin (jenis 1) atau sel tidak bergerak balas (jenis 2) → glukosa darah tinggi.

keyPoints.en: Growth hormone: too much in childhood → gigantism; too little → dwarfism; too much in adults → acromegaly.
keyPoints.bm: Hormon pertumbuhan: terlalu banyak semasa kanak-kanak → gigantisme; terlalu sedikit → kekerdilan; terlalu banyak semasa dewasa → akromegali.

keyPoints.en: Thyroxine: too little → cretinism (children), myxoedema (adults); too much → hyperthyroidism. Iodine deficiency → goitre.
keyPoints.bm: Tiroksina: terlalu sedikit → kretinisme (kanak-kanak), miksedema (dewasa); terlalu banyak → hipertiroidisme. Kekurangan iodin → goiter.

keyPoints.en: ADH deficiency → diabetes insipidus (large volumes of dilute urine).
keyPoints.bm: Kekurangan ADH → diabetes insipidus (air kencing cair dalam isi padu besar).

question.en: Why is iodised salt sold in Malaysia?
question.bm: Mengapa garam beriodin dijual di Malaysia?

answer.en: Iodine is needed to make thyroxine; it prevents goitre and cretinism.
answer.bm: Iodin diperlukan untuk menghasilkan tiroksina; ia mencegah goiter dan kretinisme.

tip.en: For each disorder: hormone, too much or too little, and the symptoms.
tip.bm: Bagi setiap gangguan: hormon, terlalu banyak atau sedikit, dan simptom.
